import time
from src.jobs import Job

def test_wait_does_not_poll_with_sleep(monkeypatch):
    def forbidden_sleep(_):
        raise AssertionError('polling sleep is not allowed')
    monkeypatch.setattr(time, 'sleep', forbidden_sleep)
    job = Job()
    job.start()
    assert job.wait_until_ready(1.0)

def test_timeout_is_respected():
    job = Job()
    assert job.wait_until_ready(0.01) is False
